definitions.explanation: An examination held at the end of an academic term or semester to assess students' learning over the entire period.

examples.japanese: {来週|らいしゅう}から{期末試験|きまつしけん}が{始|はじ}まる。
{期末試験|きまつしけん}の{勉強|べんきょう}で{忙|いそが}しい。
{期末試験|きまつしけん}の{範囲|はんい}は{教科書|きょうかしょ}の{後半|こうはん}だ。
examples.english: The final exam covers the second half of the textbook.

notes:
FORMATION:
{期末|きまつ} (end of term) + {試験|しけん} (exam)

SCHOOL YEAR CONTEXT:
Japanese schools typically have:
・{一学期|いちがっき} (first term) - April to July
・{二学期|にがっき} (second term) - September to December
・{三学期|さんがっき} (third term) - January to March

Each term may have a {期末試験|きまつしけん} at its end.

RELATED TERMS:
・{中間試験|ちゅうかんしけん} - Midterm exam
・{追試験|ついしけん} - Makeup exam
・{試験期間|しけんきかん} - Exam period

COLLOQUIAL:
Often shortened to:
・{期末|きまつ} (finals)
・{期末テスト|きまつてすと} (final test)
